tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background and the active tab. Text on it: ink, ink-soft, ink-muted.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: The gutter around terminal and SFTP panes, and code boxes inside panels.

tokens.name: terminal
tokens.usage: Terminal pane background. Terminal text: ink-soft, ink-dim.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Side navigation, right-hand detail panels, pane headers, status bar.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, fields, table containers, dialogs, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: card-selected
tokens.usage: A selected card or table row.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The title bar, the active navigation item, a pressed segmented button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px borders and row dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of secondary buttons, dialogs and the search field.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a pane, where line would be too heavy.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: file icons, breadcrumb separators, the track of a switch that is off. Too low in contrast for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Terminal output and code text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, inactive links and icons. Passes 4.5:1 on ground through raised.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmed terminal text only (timestamps, labels). Use on terminal or ground, not on raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected borders, links, focus rings, the logo, and the Production group.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: group-violet
tokens.usage: Group color: Staging by default. Also remote port forwards and symlinks.

tokens.name: group-mint
tokens.usage: Group color: Home lab by default. Also success words in terminal output.

tokens.name: group-gray
tokens.usage: Group color: Clients by default, and any group without a hue.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings and destructive actions only: key mismatch, delete, broadcast, failures.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill.

tokens.name: warn-surface
tokens.usage: Background of a warning dialog or banner. Body text on it: warn-ink.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of a destructive outline button.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Body text on warn-surface.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per screen: the page title.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in cards and rows, button labels (600 on filled buttons).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines and field labels, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and table headers. Always uppercase, in ink-muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Terminal text, addresses and values in detail rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon button and its neighbour.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, and between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel and dialog padding; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page content side padding.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, fields and table rows.

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Height of controls inside toolbars, tabs and pane headers.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags and keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tab top corners and icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, panes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, table containers, primary actions on a page header.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Host cards and icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Cast by a right-hand panel onto the page.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: A card on hover, with a 1px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette, over a 60% black backdrop.
